verses_he.label: القرار
lines: וְעַתָּה אַתָּה בֵּינֵינוּ וְלֹא רָחוֹק מִמֶּנּוּ
שֹׁמֵעַ אוֹתָנוּ, מְמַלֵּא אוֹתָנוּ בְּרוּחֲךָ מֵחָדָשׁ
וְתִתְרוֹעֵעַ תְּהוֹמֵנוּ: אִתְּךָ לֹא נֶחְסַר דָּבָר
וְהִתְהַלְּכֵנוּ יָעִיד כִּי אַתָּה אָדוֹן נִכְבָּד

review: The hymn is the Christ who breaks and heals: 1:1–8 is Ps 107:14 with Dan 2:22 and Jer 23:29, the chorus is Matt 18:20 with Heb 13:5 and Eph 5:18, and 2:1–8 is Ps 107:29 with Mic 7:19 and Col 3:3–4.
The chorus is printed as a block of four long lines between the two eight-line stanzas, and the corpus records the shape as 8/4/8; the payload keeps the block rather than distributing it.

1:4 תִּגַּע בּוֹ וְיֵהָפֵךְ לְאֵשׁ — the Arabic تَلْمِسُهُ يُحَالُ نَار is 'You touch it and it turns to fire'; the Hebrew uses נָגַע with הָפַךְ, the pair of Exod 4:6 and 1 Sam 10:6, so the change is a real transformation and not a warm feeling.
